commentDescription.message: Save a comment to post and pin automatically.

commentPlaceholder.message: Everyone is welcome! Say hello in chat.

commentCategoryHint.message: Leave blank to use the default. The category on Twitch at posting time is used. Apply edits with Save settings.

commentAutoPost.message: Post once when a stream starts

commentDetails.message: While Chrome is running, only the stream status is checked about once a minute. If you enable this during a live stream, it posts once for that stream too. Pinning replaces the current pin. In Shared Chat, the comment is also sent to the shared channels.

loginReauthorizePrompt.message: Log in again to enable chat posting and pinning. Your saved settings will be kept.

commentUnsaved.message: Unsaved changes — use Save settings to apply.

commentWaiting.message: No delivery recorded yet. Automatic posting is off unless enabled above.

commentOffline.message: Offline. The comment will be posted when a live stream is detected if automatic posting is enabled.

commentSent.message: Posted for this stream. It will not be posted again.

commentPinned.message: Posted and pinned for this stream. It will not be posted again after the pin expires or is removed.

commentSendFailed.message: Not posted. Check the error, then use Post now / retry. No automatic resend will be attempted for this stream.

commentPinFailed.message: The comment was posted, but pinning failed. Post now / retry retries only the pin with the original duration.

commentDeliveryUnknown.message: Delivery could not be confirmed. To avoid duplicates, this stream will not be retried. Check Twitch chat and post or pin manually if needed.

commentPinInterrupted.message: Pinning was interrupted. Check Twitch, then retry the pin if needed.

errorCommentPermissions.message: Log in again and allow the requested access.

errorCommentAuthCheck.message: Could not check Twitch permissions. Try again later.

errorCommentStreamCheck.message: Could not check the live stream. No comment was posted.

errorCommentAccount.message: The saved comment belongs to a different login. Review the comment and save settings for this account before posting.

errorCommentLength.message: Each comment must be 500 characters or fewer.

errorCommentEmpty.message: No comment is set for this category. Save a default or category comment first.

errorCommentDropped.message: Twitch did not send the comment: $reason$

errorTitleTooLong.message: The expanded title is $count$ characters; the maximum is $max$.
errorTitleTooLong.description: Error when an expanded stream title exceeds the Twitch title limit.
